dedup_definition: Only byte-identical full raw records within one ASIN share a logical ID; every original record remains mapped and queryable.
movie_scope: single_work product mappings only; compilations product-only, no copying to members; identity status always displayed.
score_denominator: Valid non-NULL scores from each within-product logical representative, each counted once; not people, cast, assertions or number of raw copies.
cross_edition_uncertainty: 243 pairs are unresolved review-identity candidates, not automatically deleted/merged. Aggregate may include repeated postings across editions; it is not claimed as a fully cross-edition deduplicated count of independent opinions.
join_safety: Aggregate logical representatives by product before joining product-to-work mapping. Never aggregate after joining one-to-many credits/source assertions.
future_review: Resolve candidate pairs with evidence, preserve raw-to-logical mappings/version history, then rerun statistics under a new explicit policy/version if cross-edition logical identities change.
